indication.text: Treatment of the cardiomyopathy of wild-type or hereditary transthyretin-mediated amyloidosis (ATTR-CM) in adults to reduce cardiovascular mortality and cardiovascular-related hospitalization.

citations.quote: VIYDAQEL and VIYDAMAX are indicated for the treatment of the cardiomyopathy of wild type or hereditary transthyretin-mediated amyloidosis (ATTR-CM) in adults to reduce cardiovascular mortality and cardiovascular-related hospitalization.

target_moa.text: Tafamidis is a transthyretin (TTR) stabilizer; it binds to one of the thyroxine (T4) binding sites on the TTR tetramer, stabilizing the tetramer and preventing its dissociation into monomers, which reduces amyloid formation and deposition.

citations.quote: In this condition, transthyretin homo-tetramers dissociate into monomeric components, become misfolded, and are deposited into tissues to which they are toxic.

Tafamidis, which circulates as the free acid regardless of which drug product is administered, binds to one of the T4 binding sites, thereby stabilizing the tetramer and preventing its dissociation into monomeric components.
